watches.name: Hard Candy Enamel - Black Licorice
watches.description: Allow us to introduce you to our long awaited Black Licorice Flavor. The Hard Candy enamel series is our first watch just for fun. These watches have a real glass fired enamel dial in a rich color invoking the luminosity and shine of your favorite Hard Candy. In addition to the deep and rich dial the enamel series watches utilize our now iconic and signature numerals this time crafted in Lumicast. The numerals and markers accentuate the depth of the dial through their 3D construction in solid lume blocks creating light and shadow while the custom hands sweep by. The “Telford case” is 37mm in diameter, 10.35mm high (including the boxed sapphire crystal), 43mm from lug to lug with a 20mm lug width. This watch is designed to hug the wrist utilizing that familiar design and DNA architecture of American watches from the mid 20th Century. Each Black Licorice comes with a black tapered strap. Other colored straps available for purchase here . The watch is powered by an automatic Miyota 9039 with 24 jewels. Closed stainless steel case back with embossed Markwell logo. Water resistant to 10 bar or 100 meters when the crown is fully pushed in. Luminescent Numerals, Markers, and hands. Second hand colored tipped to match your dial.

watches.name: "datematic" - Stainless w/ Kelli Green Dial
watches.description: The “ datematic ” is our first automatic powered watch with a date display window at the 3 o”clock position. The date is centered in a wedge shape, framed in a window displaying yesterday, today and tomorrow. The date is a roulette style alternating color depending on odd or even day and color of the dial and case. Easter egg on certain models on certain days. The “ Telford case ” is 37mm in diameter, 10.35 mm high (including the boxed sapphire crystal), 43mm from lug to lug with a 20mm lug width. This watch is designed to hug the wrist utilizing that familiar design and DNA architecture of American watches from the mid 20th century. Each watch is supplied with a 20mm soft leather strap and case color matched, signed pin buckle. Other colored straps available for purchase here . The watch is powered by a Sellita SW200-1 26 jewel automatic Swiss movement regulated +6/-4 averaged per day. Closed stainless steel case back with an embossed Markwell logo. Water resistant to 10 bar or 100 meters when the crown is fully pushed in. Luminescent hands and logo in crown.

watches.name: Memento Mori - Stainless steel
watches.description: Memento Mori loosely translates from Latin to “Remember thou art mortal”. Time is fleeting and the best way to mark that time is with this fine Swiss Made watch. The “ Telford case ” is 37mm in diameter, 10.5mm high (including the boxed sapphire crystal), 43mm from lug to lug with a 20mm lug width. This watch is designed to hug the wrist utilizing that familiar design and DNA architecture of American watches from the mid 20th century. As both owners of Markwell Watches are proud Freemasons our first dial is a Masonic dial also reminiscent of those American watches available to our grandfathers. Each watch is supplied with a 20mm soft leather strap and case color matched, signed pin buckle. The watch is powered by a Sellita SW200 26 jewel automatic Swiss movement with a signed rotor viewed through the sapphire case back. Each case back has a ghosted image of a skull and crossbones. Water resistant to 10 bar or 100 meters when the crown is fully pushed in. Luminescent logo in crown. The watch is available to everybody, not just Masons.
